vv39:1.1: Mañjeṭṭhake vimānasmiṃ soṇṇavālukasanthate pañcaṅgikena turiyena ramasi suppavādite. || ||
vv39:2.1: Tamhā vimānā oruyha nimmitā ratanāmayā ogāhasi sālavanaṃ pupphitaṃ sabbakālikaṃ. || ||
vv39:3.1: Yassa yass' eva sālassa mūle tiṭṭhasi devate so so muñcati pupphāni onamitvā dumuttamo. || ||
vv39:4.1: Vāteritaṃ sālavanaṃ ādhutaṃ dijasevitaṃ vāti gandho disā sabbā rukkho mañjūsako yathā. || ||
vv39:5.1: Ghāyase taṃ sucigandhaṃ rūpaṃ passasi amānusaṃ devate pucchitācikkha kissa kammass' idaṃ phalan ti. || ||
vv39:6.1: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūtā dāsī ayirakule ahuṃ buddhaṃ nisinnaṃ disvāna sālapupphehi okiriṃ. || ||
vv39:7.1: Vaṭaṃsakañ ca sukataṃ sālapupphamayaṃ ahaṃ buddhassa upanāmesiṃ pasannā sehi pāṇihi. || ||
vv39:8.1: Tāhaṃ kammaṃ karitvāna kusalaṃ buddhavaṇṇitaṃ apetasokā sukhitā sampamodām' anāmayā ti. || ||
